title: Bsp1, a fungal CPI motif protein, regulates actin filament capping in endocytosis and cytokinesis
authors: Hummel DR; Hakala M; Toret CP; Kaksonen M
one_liner_zh: 该文研究真菌CPI基序蛋白Bsp1调控肌动蛋白丝加帽的机制，对象为折叠蛋白肌动蛋白体系，无无序蛋白/相分离背景，且无AI或物理模拟方法，仅实验表征，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: The capping of barbed filament ends is a fundamental mechanism for actin regulation. Capping protein controls filament growth and actin turnover in cells by binding to the barbed ends of the filaments with high affinity and slow off-rate. The interaction between Capping protein and actin is regulated by capping protein interaction (CPI) motif proteins. We identified a novel CPI motif protein, Bsp1, which is involved in cytokinesis and endocytosis in budding yeast. We demonstrate that Bsp1 is an actin binding protein with a high affinity for capping protein via its CPI motif. In cells, Bsp1 regulates capping protein at endocytic sites and is a major recruiter of capping protein to the cytokinetic actin ring. Lastly, we define Bsp1-related proteins as a distinct fungi-specific CPI protein group. Our results suggest that Bsp1 promotes actin filament capping by the capping protein. This study establishes Bsp1 as a new capping protein regulator and promising candidate to regulate actin networks in fungi.
abstract_zh: 肌动蛋白丝末端加帽是肌动蛋白调控的基本机制。加帽蛋白通过高亲和力结合丝状末端且解离速率缓慢，控制细胞中肌动蛋白丝的生长和肌动蛋白周转。加帽蛋白与肌动蛋白之间的相互作用受加帽蛋白相互作用（CPI）基序蛋白的调控。我们鉴定了一种新型CPI基序蛋白Bsp1，它参与芽殖酵母的细胞分裂和胞吞作用。我们证明Bsp1是一种肌动蛋白结合蛋白，通过其CPI基序对加帽蛋白具有高亲和力。在细胞中，Bsp1在内吞位点调控加帽蛋白，并且是将加帽蛋白招募至胞质分裂肌动蛋白环的主要因子。最后，我们将Bsp1相关蛋白定义为一个独特的真菌特异性CPI蛋白组。我们的结果表明，Bsp1通过加帽蛋白促进肌动蛋白丝加帽。本研究确立了Bsp1作为一种新的加帽蛋白调控因子，并作为调控真菌肌动蛋白网络的有前景候选分子。
